entities.name: Query 768-aa phosphatase
observations: Sequence length is 768 aa; estimated molecular mass is 86.6 kDa and theoretical pI is 6.26.
Contains an N-terminal RA_3 domain prediction at residues 58–138 and multiple leucine-rich repeat predictions across the C-terminal region.
Shows 34.4% identity and 88.7% query coverage to reviewed C. elegans PHLPP-like protein Q09564; E-value 5.3e-41.
Catalytic assignment is inferred from homology and is not direct experimental evidence for this query sequence.

entities.name: Q09564 PHLPP-like phosphatase
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Caenorhabditis elegans annotated as a probable protein phosphatase.
Annotated EC 3.1.3.16 and GO protein serine/threonine phosphatase activity.
Contains a long chain and multiple LRR features in the reference annotation.

entities.name: Protein ser/thr dephosphorylation
observations: Candidate reaction: O-phospho-L-seryl-[protein] + H2O → L-seryl-[protein] + phosphate.
Candidate reaction: O-phospho-L-threonyl-[protein] + H2O → L-threonyl-[protein] + phosphate.
Mapped in the retrieved evidence to Rhea entries RHEA:11604, RHEA:20629, RHEA:9863 and RHEA:11060, RHEA:11605, RHEA:47004.

entities.name: Mn2+ cofactor
observations: Mn2+ is annotated as a cofactor for the reviewed PHLPP-like reference protein Q09564; cofactor transfer to the query remains homology-based.
